title: Looking for constructive feedback on my algorithmic trading channel (NQBotLive) — Where can I improve?
author: Key-Put-7779
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’ve been working on my YouTube channel, NQBotLive, which focuses on algorithmic trading, insights, and quantitative tools.

While I’m passionate about what I share, I really want to make sure the content is as clear, engaging, and genuinely useful as possible for this community. If you have a few spare minutes to check out the live feed, it's like a mini CNBC hosted by Codex and Deepseek, I would deeply appreciate any honest critique.

Whether it's about pacing, video structure, technical explanations, or audio/visual quality—please let me know what I'm doing well and, more importantly, where I need the most improvement.

Thanks in advance for your time and guidance!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: a live feed is hard to critique from a link, nobody sits through enough of it to judge. cut one 60 second clip where the bot makes a call and then show what price did next, people will give you real feedback on that.
